purpose: Additive branch-scoped Megablock questions; frozen evaluations unchanged.

questions.query: How does Seeded Typology Megablock guarantee coherent varied architecture without mutable negotiation?
facts: A deterministic four-by-four programme selects a continuous core, an interior atrium, a bridge with both landings, habitation and lower supports.
Neighbour cooperation is intra-supercell; a common lower transfer slab crosses supercells.
Complete-supercell guarantees exclude clipping, shaft carving, deterioration and later paths.

questions.query: Which existing controls alter Seeded Typology Megablock and how does it differ from classic repeating samplers or GENTEK-SWARM?
facts: Room size and floor height scale lots, wall thickness changes mass, windows affect habitation only, and doors open the lower arcade gateway.
Bay and floor height must be at least six wall thicknesses plus twelve cells.
It remains an immutable schema-four module v1, with no editor, new material schema, search or runtime negotiation.
